originalTitle: SoftBank donated $50 million to Trump’s library months before federal data center deal
summary: SoftBank contributed $50 million to the Trump Presidential Library in January, just months before announcing that it's leasing land from the federal government to build a sprawling data center in Ohio. content: SoftBank contributed $50 million to the Trump Presidential Library in January, just months before announcing that it’s leasing land from the federal government to build a sprawling data center in Ohio. The Japanese company revealed the timing in response to a June letter from Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-MA), Sen. Richard Blumenthal (D-CT), and Rep. Melanie Stansbury (D-NM), which raised concerns about bribery. “Are we expected to believe it’s a coincidence that two months after Softbank donated $50 million to the Trump library, his administration announced a massive lease deal for Softbank’s data center?” Sen. Warren said in a statement to The Verge. “Again and again, it seems like Trump is putting handshake deals with CEOs over what’s best for Americans.” In March, SoftBank said its SB Energy subsidiary formed a public-private partnership to build “the world’s largest” AI data center at the US Department of Energy’s site in Portsmouth, Ohio. As part of the partnership, SB Energy will build a massive gas-fired powerplant nearby, with a capacity of at least 9.2 gigawatts. As the lawmakers note in their initial letter, SoftBank has made contributions to the presidential libraries of Ronald Reagan and George W. Bush, but only “after those presidents had left office and after the relevant library foundations and institutions had been established.” With Trump’s presidential library, however, SoftBank donated during Trump’s term and “before any presidential library has been constructed.”  Additionally, the organization responsible for taking donations, the Donald J. Trump Presidential Library Fund, had been dissolved by the state of Florida last September after failing to file an annual report. SoftBank says in its response that it made its $50 million contribution to the Donald J. Trump Presidential Library Foundation, Inc. Donald Trump’s son, Eric Trump, is a trustee of the nonprofit, Citizens for Ethics reports. “As with its prior contributions to Presidential libraries, SoftBank understands that this donation will be used to support the construction and operation of the Donald J. Trump Presidential Library,” SoftBank’s letter reads.
chineseTitle: 软银在联邦数据中心交易前几个月向特朗普图书馆捐赠了 5000 万美元
chineseSummary: 软银一月份向特朗普总统图书馆捐赠了 5000 万美元，就在几个月前，软银宣布从联邦政府租赁土地，在俄亥俄州建设一个庞大的数据中心。这家日本公司在回应参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦 (D-MA)、参议员理查德·布卢门撒尔 (D-CT) 和众议员梅兰妮 6 月份的一封信时透露了这一时间安排 […]
chineseContent: 软银一月份向特朗普总统图书馆捐赠了 5000 万美元，就在几个月前，软银宣布从联邦政府租赁土地，在俄亥俄州建设一座庞大的数据中心。这家日本公司是为了回应参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦 (D-MA)、参议员理查德·布卢门撒尔 (D-CT) 和众议员梅兰妮·斯坦斯伯里 (D-NM) 6 月份的一封信而透露了这一时间安排，信中提出了对贿赂的担忧。 “软银向特朗普图书馆捐赠 5000 万美元两个月后，他的政府宣布了软银数据中心的大规模租赁协议，我们是否会相信这是一个巧合？”沃伦参议员在给 The Verge 的一份声明中说道。 “特朗普似乎一次又一次地将与首席执行官的握手协议置于对美国人最有利的位置之上。”今年 3 月，软银表示，其 SB Energy 子公司建立了公私合作伙伴关系，在美国能源部位于俄亥俄州朴茨茅斯的基地建设“世界上最大的”人工智能数据中心。作为合作伙伴关系的一部分，SB Energy 将在附近建造一座大型燃气发电厂，容量至少为 9.2 吉瓦。正如立法者在最初的信中指出的那样，软银已经向罗纳德·里根和乔治·W·布什的总统图书馆捐款，但只是“在这些总统卸任后以及相关图书馆基金会和机构建立之后”。然而，对于特朗普的总统图书馆，软银在特朗普任期内以及“在任何总统图书馆建成之前”就进行了捐赠。  此外，负责接受捐款的组织唐纳德·J·特朗普总统图书馆基金因未能提交年度报告而于去年 9 月被佛罗里达州解散。软银在回应中表示，它向 D 项目捐款了 5000 万美元。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
